main.description: Check enrollment status for a DID in this Stratos service.

did.description: The DID to check enrollment for.

enrolled.description: Whether the DID is enrolled in this Stratos service.

eligible.description: Whether the DID is eligible to enroll. Only included when the DID is not enrolled. Omitted when the eligibility check cannot complete.

active.description: Whether the enrollment is active. Only included when enrolled.

enrolledAt.description: When the DID was enrolled, if enrolled.

signingKey.description: The service-held signing key DID for this enrollment. Only included when enrolled.

enrollmentRkey.description: Record key of the zone.stratos.actor.enrollment record on the user's PDS. Only included when enrolled.

boundaries.description: Authoritative boundaries assigned. Only included when request is authenticated.
